nodes.description: UE in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST message to AMF
UE starts timer T3510
Is timer T3502 running?
UE stops timer T3502
Is timer T3511 running?
UE stops timer T3511
Is SUCI included in 5GS mobile identity IE AND timer T3519 is NOT running?
UE starts timer T3519 and stores the value of the SUCI
Emergency Registration over Current Access: Already registered for emergency services over the non-current access?
Emergency Registration over non-3GPP Access: Can register for emergency services over 3GPP access?
Valid 4G-GUTI Available after Interworking without N26 and 'interworking without N26 interface not supported' indication received?

Create a 5G-GUTI mapped from the valid native 4G-GUTI and indicate the mapped 5G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE, include the UE status IE with the EMM registration status set to 'UE is not in EMM-REGISTERED state' and include an ATTACH REQUEST message in the EPS NAS message container IE.
Valid 5G-GUTI available?
Include the 5G-GUTI in the Additional GUTI IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message
Valid 5G NAS security context?
UE needs to send non-cleartext IEs
Send a REGISTRATION REQUEST message including the NAS message container IE
Send a REGISTRATION REQUEST message without including the NAS message container IE
UE is operating in the dual-registration mode and it is in EMM state EMM-REGISTERED?
Include the UE status IE with the EMM registration status set to 'UE is in EMM-REGISTERED state'
Ciphered broadcast assistance data is supported and new ciphering keys are requested?
Include the Additional information requested IE with the CipherKey bit set to 'ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data requested'

Disaster roaming services and the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition is the HPLMN and: 1) the Additional GUTI IE is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and does not contain a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by the HPLMN; or 2) the Additional GUTI IE is not included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the 5GS mobile identity IE contains neither the SUCI nor a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by the HPLMN?
Include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition IE indicating the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition.

Disaster roaming services and the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition is not the HPLMN and: 1) the Additional GUTI IE is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and does not contain a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition; or 2) the Additional GUTI IE is not included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the 5GS mobile identity IE does not contain a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition?
Include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition IE indicating the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition.
